title: Electricity to make or remake a kilogram of aluminium
description: Bar chart. Kilowatt-hours per kilogram of aluminium: remelting scrap, about 0.8 (5 per cent of primary production's energy); the theoretical minimum for the Hall–Héroult reaction, 6.23; Faraday's charge at an assumed 4 volts and perfect current efficiency, 11.9; a typical smelter, 15.37. Data: Wikipedia, Hall–Héroult process and Aluminium recycling; the 0.8 and 11.9 are by our arithmetic.
heading: KILOWATT-HOURS PER KILOGRAM OF ALUMINIUM
